subject: Shiny crashing after installing dev version

messages.subject: Shiny crashing after installing dev version
parts:
I installed the dev version of shiny through devtools and it gave me an error saying package 'httpuv' wasn't up to date. So I went and installed the new httpuv, came back and installed shiny, and it worked. 

However, whenever I run the 'runApp' function now, Rstudio crashes. It doesn't matter what I pass to it, whether it's an app or nothing, Rstudio immediately crashes with the following message:

Has anyone had a similar problem? I tried removing httpuv and all shiny packages and re-installing them but I'm getting the same errors.

Thanks.
